summary: E2E tested three new features on ClientVerse: (1) MCP Level-2 reversible write tools with approval gating, (2) Live webhooks with signed delivery + retry + DLQ + replay, (3) Client Outcome Graph per workspace. All acceptance criteria met via Playwright against the public preview URL using admin creds. Full flow: login → /mcp → selected create_task (L2 badge visible) → workspace select (Northwind Delivery) → title 'TEST_MCP_L2_task' → Invoke returned status pending_approval with amber approval box + approval id in mcp-result → Execution History row shows status pending_approval → opened workspace → Approvals tab shows 'MCP write: create_task' (kind mcp_write) → clicked Approve → new task 'TEST_MCP_L2_task' appears in Tasks tab → back to /mcp, execution history flipped to success. Webhooks: /registries → Webhooks tab showed both seeded endpoints; Send test on Local Test Sink = delivered, on Ops Alerts (external) = failed (expected — DLQ after 3 attempts, per design); Replay works; toggle enable and rotate secret work; new webhook created via dialog (TEST_WH). Outcome Graph: /workspaces/{id} → Outcome tab renders goals (2), commitments (2), health node, and 'Health Over Time' chart (SVG present); 'Add outcome' prompt creates a new goal (TEST_new_goal) that renders immediately. Regression: L1 read tool get_pipeline_summary still invokes and returns non-approval result; Dashboard/Pipeline/Directory/Workspaces load without errors.

issues: Workspaces.jsx uses Promise.all across /workspaces, /companies, /dashboard with no catch; if any request momentarily errors (observed one transient 401 during nav race after login) the entire list stays empty until reload. Consider Promise.allSettled or setRows even if healthMap fails. Cosmetic — recovers on reload/direct navigation.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1185 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; recommend splitting into modules (auth, workspaces, mcp, webhooks, outcomes) for maintainability.
OutcomeGraph 'Add outcome' uses window.prompt() — works but violates the guideline against using browser default dialogs; consider a shadcn Dialog + Input for consistency.
Workspaces.jsx load() has no try/catch; a single failing sub-request wipes the UI list. Use Promise.allSettled or separate awaits with fallbacks.
WebhookManager: Replay button always shown even for already-delivered rows — consider gating by status for clarity (minor UX).
seed_data_creation: During test: 1 MCP-invoked task 'TEST_MCP_L2_task' in Northwind Delivery workspace, 1 webhook endpoint 'TEST_WH' pointing to https://example.com/hook, 1 outcome goal 'TEST_new_goal'. These are safe test artifacts and can be cleaned up if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features working end-to-end. MCP L2 write tools (create_task/add_note) correctly return pending_approval and only execute after Approvals tab approval. Webhooks dispatch, retry, DLQ, replay, toggle, rotate all functional. Outcome Graph renders per-workspace goals/commitments/health + line chart; add_outcome via prompt() works. Ops Alerts webhook failures are BY DESIGN (unreachable URL demonstrates retry+DLQ) — do not flag. Backend endpoints of interest: /api/mcp/tools, /api/mcp/invoke, /api/approvals/{id} (PATCH), /api/webhooks*, /api/webhook-deliveries*, /api/outcomes, /api/workspaces/{id}/outcome-graph.
